candidates.item: Actively recruiting design partners, collaborators, and waitlist signups.
candidates.why_interesting: Seeking 'design partners' specifically — not just beta users — signals they want co-builders who will shape the product, a deliberate early-stage GTM move that's worth noting. It's a concrete, observable stance rather than a generic 'sign up' call.
candidates.recency_note: Confirmed live as of research date; stealth-mode company so this is one of very few public signals.

candidates.item: LinkedIn job posting for 'Founding Engineer, AI Infra' at Goaly AI, located in San Francisco, posted ~3 weeks ago.
candidates.why_interesting: Hiring for AI Infrastructure specifically — not a product engineer, not a generalist — as the *founding* engineering role is a distinctive signal. It suggests the core bet is on the underlying platform/infra layer, not just wrapping existing APIs. That's a meaningful architectural stance for an enterprise AI company to make this early.
candidates.recency_note: Posted approximately 3 weeks before research date; role may have been filled.

excluded_with_reason.reason: Pure marketing tagline — sloganeering with no concrete mechanism behind it surfaced in research. Cannot be reacted to, only parroted back. Excluded per rules.
